pages.text:
Chapter 1 Neural Coding
Neural coding describes how information is represented by patterns of activity.
A rate code uses firing frequency, while a temporal code uses spike timing. These mechanisms are hypotheses supported by experiments.

Chapter 2 Evidence and limits
Measurements are noisy and a model can explain data without proving a mechanism.
